name: apistatuscheck
description: Check whether ChatGPT, GitHub, AWS, Discord, Stripe and about 280 other online services are down right now, from their official status pages, and see their recent incidents.

interface.shortDescription: Is a service down right now?
interface.longDescription:
API Status Check tells you whether an online service is down right now. Ask about ChatGPT, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Discord, Slack, Zoom, Stripe, Shopify, Cloudflare, Steam, Fortnite or about 270 other apps and APIs, by name or by domain. It reads the service's official status page at the moment you ask and reports the overall state, which components are affected, any active incidents and when they started, with a link to the official status page.

Ask about the past too: it lists the incidents a service has published over the last days or weeks, with impact and how long each lasted, so you can see whether a problem is new or recurring.

Useful when something stops working and you want to know whether it is you or them: a developer seeing errors from a third-party API, a team whose tools are failing, or anyone whose app will not load.

Limitations: it covers a fixed list of about 285 services and says so when a name is not on it. A status page shows what the vendor has acknowledged; problems limited to one region, network or account may not appear there. For services that publish no status feed it can only check whether the service's API responds, and it says when that is what it did.
capabilities: Check if a service is down
defaultPrompt: Is GitHub having an outage? Pushes keep failing.
Has Discord had any outages this week?

positive.description: Plain 'is X down' question by service name
positive.expected_behavior: Reads GitHub's official status page during the call and reports the overall state (for example 'all systems operational' or the affected components and active incidents), the time it checked, and a link to https://www.githubstatus.com.

positive.prompt: Is discord.com having problems? My messages won't send.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves discord.com to Discord, reports what Discord's status page says right now including any affected components and active incidents, and links the official status page. If Discord reports no issues it says the problem may be local to the user.

positive.prompt: Has OpenAI had any outages in the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the incidents OpenAI published on its status page in the last 7 days, newest first, with start time, impact and when each was resolved, or says none were published in that window.

positive.prompt: Is Zoom down? And has it had other incidents recently?
positive.expected_behavior: First reports Zoom's current status from its official status page with any affected components and active incidents, then lists the incidents Zoom published in the last 14 days.

Interprets 'cloudfare' as Cloudflare and reports Cloudflare's current status from its official status page, including any affected components and active incidents, with a link to https://www.cloudflarestatus.com.

negative.description: General knowledge question about outages, not a status check
negative.prompt: What is the difference between an outage and degraded performance?

negative.description: The user's own server is not a tracked service
negative.prompt: Is my home server at 192.168.1.20 down?

negative.description: Writing a status page is not checking one
negative.prompt: Write an incident update for our status page about a database outage.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Status checks and incident history are free inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: check_service_status (current status of about 285 online services, read live from each vendor's official status page, with affected components and active incidents) and list_recent_incidents (incidents a service published in the last 1-90 days).
